hero.title: A software and AI team that works like your own department
hero.lead: We are an engineering company at Bilkent Cyberpark in Ankara. We build software and AI systems for companies that don't have a software department, or need more than the one they have.

answer.label: In short
answer.text: Genixo Bilişim ve Teknoloji A.Ş. (Genixo) is a software and AI engineering company based in Bilkent Cyberpark, Ankara, Türkiye. It works as an external software department for SMEs and organizations, covering AI process automation with human approval, custom software, product development and NGSD, an ongoing software team model.

sections.label: Where we're going
sections.title: AI is an engineering tool. It belongs where it does measurable work.
paragraphs: AI is now a lasting part of how work gets done. We don't treat it as a trend or a shortcut. Put in the right place, it is a tool that lets a team get more done in the same time, with fewer errors.

To find that place, we first understand the work, keep people in control of the decisions and keep measuring after the system is live. Our aim is to be the team companies call when they want to move step by step, and measure as they go.

cta.title: Tell us what's slowing your team down.
cta.lead: In the first call we listen, ask how the work is done today and tell you honestly whether we can help.
